messages.text: Taurus Bay dents some lofty reputations in Rising Stars

metadata.summary: Harry Redknapp could have another top prospect on his hands after Taurus Bay made a winning chasing debut in the Boodles Rising Stars Novices’ Chase at Aintree.
metadata.content: Taurus Bay dents some lofty reputations in Rising Stars | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Taurus Bay dents some lofty reputations in Rising Stars The top guns were stumped in the Rising Stars Novices’ Chase at Aintree on Saturday as Taurus Bay made the perfect start to his chasing career with a hard-fought success over Talk To The Man. Saturday 7 November 2026 16:12, UK Image: Taurus Bay (right) ridden by Ben Jones goes on to win the Boodles Rising Stars Novices' Chase at Aintree Harry Redknapp could have another top prospect on his hands after Taurus Bay made a winning chasing debut in the Boodles Rising Stars Novices’ Chase at Aintree. A lot of the pre-race chatter revolved around Paul Nicholls' No Drama This End making his eagerly-awaited fences bow and he was sent off the 8-11 favourite. However, Ben Pauling's five-year-old was a more than useful hurdler in his own right last term and always seen as more of a chasing prospect. With No Drama This End's tank flashing empty on the run to the last it was left to Ben Jones on board Taurus Bay to outbattle the match-fit Dan Skelton runner Talk To The Man after the last, edging a one-and-a-quarter-length verdict at odds of 13-2. King's former horse Point Of Law wins Melbourne Cup Ryan Moore at his brilliant best! messages.text: Spurs to lodge complaint over Bogle tackle on Tel

metadata.summary: Tottenham will submit a formal complaint to Pro Ref following the decision not to send off Leeds United defender Jayden Bogle for his challenge on Mathys Tel in Spurs'  1-0 defeat at Elland Road.
metadata.content: Tottenham to submit complaint to Pro Ref over Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel in Leeds win at Elland Road | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Tottenham to submit complaint to Pro Ref over Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel in Leeds win at Elland Road Spurs are to submit complaint to Pro Ref over Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel; Bogle caught Tel on his Achilles, but referee John Brooks did not punish the incident further; VAR Tony Harrington opted against recommending an on-field review Saturday 7 November 2026 18:44, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from Leeds’s match against Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League Tottenham will submit a formal complaint to Pro Ref following the decision not to send off Leeds United defender Jayden Bogle for his challenge on Mathys Tel in Spurs' 1-0 defeat at Elland Road. Bogle caught Tel on his Achilles, which was awarded as a foul, but referee John Brooks did not punish the incident further as the Leeds defender escaped without even a caution. Tel was unable to continue and was substituted before half-time. Twitter This content is provided by Twitter , which may be using cookies and other technologies.
